pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Unlock the full report when you're ready.
pricing.faq1Q: Is the free plan really free?
pricing.faq1A: Yes! You get 1 assessment per month at no cost. You'll see your score, archetype, and a summary of your top strength and growth area. No credit card required.
pricing.faq2Q: What's included in a Single Report?
pricing.faq2A: The full 15-dimension breakdown with evidence-based justifications, hidden gems you're undervaluing, and a personalized action plan. You also get PDF export.
pricing.faq3A: Absolutely. Cancel your Pro subscription anytime with no questions asked.
pricing.faq4Q: What AI model powers the assessment?
pricing.faq4A: We use state-of-the-art large language models to analyze your experience across 15 PM capability dimensions.
